gap-ticket.html.name: Scoring Rules: features Zoho CRM has that CRM is missing

B01-K1-deleted-field.html.name: Scoring Rules | A field used by a scoring rule can be deleted, and the rule silently stops scoring

B02-K2-removed-value.html.name: Scoring Rules | Removing a pick list value used by a scoring rule gives no warning, and records lose their points

B03-A2-no-permission-screen.html.name: Scoring Rules | Users without permission see the page, the New button and the editor, then every call is refused

B04-G9-threshold-input.html.name: Workflow Rules | Score threshold accepts text or decimals with no message and keeps the last valid number

B05-H2-no-version-overwrite.html.name: Scoring Rules | A save without a version overwrites the rule with no conflict check

B06-H4-duplicate-names.html.name: Scoring Rules | Two creates at the same moment make two rules with the same name

B07-C19-identical-conditions.html.name: Scoring Rules | The same condition twice in one rule is accepted and counted twice

B08-I6-D15-api-conditions.html.name: Scoring Rules | The API saves conditions the screen cannot show (regex, length, any value on User fields)

B09-I3-B10-unknown-ids.html.name: Scoring Rules | Unknown rule or module ids are answered as success

B10-J6-error-focus.html.name: Scoring Rules | After a failed Create, focus stays on the button instead of the first error

B11-F9-audit-unreadable.html.name: Audit Log | Scoring rule edits show "EntriesJson: 1 item → 1 item", so the change cannot be seen

B12-WF-hosted-link-404.html.name: Web Forms | The hosted link of a web form opens "404 Not Found (nginx)" (Desk and CRM)

B13-DESK-no-permissions-page.html.name: Desk Profiles | There is no page to see or edit a profile's permissions
